_comment: Every copy of the local-vs-remote DB host classifier must answer these the same way. A LOCAL host gets TLS off by default (an explicit tls/sslmode setting still wins); a REMOTE host gets TLS on. The copies: Go api-gateway handlers.isLocalDBHost, backend-orchestrator cdc.IsLocalDBHost and assessor.isLocalAssessorMySQLHost; Python _is_local_db_host in each hand-curated DB connector and in connector_database.py.j2, plus the inline dotless checks in the postgresql, oracle and sqlserver connectors. Kubernetes in-cluster names (*.svc, *.cluster.local) are local for the same reason a dotless docker service name is: neither suffix resolves on public DNS, so only an in-cluster service can answer to it. Tests: shared/mcp-connectors/tests/test_local_db_host_golden.py and a Go test beside each Go copy.
